I got these to put my homemade lotion in.  They are great, no leaks. I'll be ordering more of these.

It leaks like crazy. The liquid was not very hot. I didn't want to destroy the value of the ingredients by heating too much. A couple of minutes after pouring it into the tube it was all over the dish I set them in for holding. Very little remained in the tube. The tube is sturdy and nice, but hardly any product stays inside it for use. If they would solve that problem I would have given it 5 stars.

I love these tubes. These worked great.  Of the 6 I ordered, 2 leaked when I filled them full of water. For the 2 leaky one’s. I put the tubes in the freezer, added a small amount of luke warm ingredients and then put it back in the freezer. Once it set up, I filled the remainder of the tube. Worked like a charm. No leaks.

claims.text: Many customers report that the tubes leak, especially when hot liquid is poured in, wasting their ingredients.
Several customers praise the quality and design, noting the bottom mechanism moves up to dispense all the product.
Some customers find the internal dispensing mechanism fragile or prone to snapping/breaking.
A few customers note minor cosmetic issues like scratchy edges.
Some customers report no leaks when pouring cooler liquid, finding them perfect for DIY body products.
